summary_zh: 之后又按正常面试题的写法重写了题干（中英文页都用英文题干），数字和条件不变。

issues.problem_zh: 原题干是一大段长句，把条件、规模、范围和要讨论的话题全挤在一起，读起来不像面试官会说的话；中文版又是逐句硬翻。
issues.change_zh: 按正常面试题的写法重写题干：先一句话说要设计什么，再分块列出已有条件、需求和规模、要交付什么、面试官会追问的话题和不考的范围。所有数字和条件不变，参考解答没有改。按用户要求，中文页的题干也直接用英文。

checked: ran page (both languages); code blocks identical in README.md and README.zh.md
recomputed every scale figure in my own script: 7.2e10 readings/day, 576 GB/day, 52M rows/year, 5,000 positives per snapshot, 20% recall cap, 30/7=4.3, 5,000*7/30=1,167 (~1,170) new replacements/week
recomputed cost figures: saved = 20*TP - 1,000 gives 19,000 (perfect) and -900 (random, TP=5); break-even risk 1/20 = 5%
ROC-AUC example: analytic AUC 0.817, analytic precision at top 0.1% 0.158, FPR 0.00085 -- matches the page's 0.82 / under 20% / under 0.1%
down-sampling correction: independent stratified simulation (2M rows, r=0.1, non-logistic binned estimator) reproduces p' = p/(p + r(1-p)) and the correction formula
censoring biases: independent vectorised simulation with three parameter sets -- unresolved-as-negative < true rate < unresolved-dropped in all three
gradient-boosting negative gradient y - sigma(F) checked numerically
read the deployment diagram edge by edge against the prose; compared Chinese and English text paragraph by paragraph

code_run.notes: README.md and README.zh.md both pass (about 7 s each).
